def: Controller Status bit indicating that the controller has temporarily paused command processing, for example while activating new firmware without a reset. Completions are delayed, not lost; the host should wait rather than reset.

exp: Controller Ready Independent of Media Enable
def: Controller Configuration bit (NVMe 2.0 and later) that lets a controller report CSTS.RDY = 1 before its media is ready, when CAP.CRMS allows it. Namespaces may then report Namespace Not Ready until media is available; timeouts come from the CRTO property.
Identify Controller field reporting whether the controller is an I/O controller, a discovery controller or an administrative controller. Devices predating controller types report 0 (not reported).
The NQN of an NVM subsystem, reported in Identify Controller by every controller of that subsystem. Hosts group controllers into one subsystem by comparing it.
Controller Status bit set after an NVM Subsystem Reset; cleared by writing 1. Lets a host distinguish a deliberate subsystem reset from a power or link failure.

Optional property (NVMe 2.0 and later, advertised by CAP.NSSS) through which a host requests shutdown of the whole NVM subsystem rather than one controller. Confirm offset and fields in the Base Specification.
A part of a large NVM subsystem that can fail or be power-managed independently of other parts; some log pages and features are domain-scoped.
Linux feature that presents one block device per shared namespace and routes I/O over the controllers (paths) of the subsystem, using the SUBNQN and namespace identifiers to match paths.
